"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work, along with other pro-peace forces in the American Jewish, Arab, and broader progressive community, to pressure the Obama administration to adopt a balanced Middle-East approach.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA urges pressure on Israel to freeze any settlement activity as a prelude to abandoning them in an effort to bring peace.",
